zh.title: 新加坡航空調整十一小時A380航線 杜拜服務改由A350執飛
zh.summary: 新加坡航空調整A380航線；杜拜改由A350執飛；奧克蘭連結數十目的地
body: 新加坡航空已證實對其一條航程達11小時的空中巴士 A380 航線進行重大調整。根據 Simple Flying 的報導，此項舉措重新調整了該航空公司的 A380 航線網絡，其中將杜拜航線的服務改為由空中巴士 A350 客機執飛。此外，其奧克蘭的航線連結也將協助輸送旅客至數十個後續目的地。
根據 Simple Flying 先前的報導，新加坡航空共規劃了10條空中巴士 A380 航線，其中倫敦與雪梨為該航空 A380 網絡的核心樞紐，而印度與澳大拉西亞地區則組成其餘部分。此外，該公司先前也曾規劃將其空中巴士 A380 的航班運量提升約百分之二十五。

en.title: Singapore Airlines Confirms Major Adjustments to 11-Hour Airbus A380 Route
en.summary: Singapore Airlines adjusts its eleven-hour Airbus A380 route, swapping Dubai flights to Airbus A350 aircraft.
body: Singapore Airlines has confirmed a major adjustment to one of its 11-hour Airbus A380 routes. According to a report by Simple Flying, this operational adjustment reshuffles the carrier's A380 flight network, which includes swapping its Dubai services to Airbus A350 aircraft. Additionally, its Auckland services are designed to feed dozens of onward destinations.

This adjustment follows earlier developments in the airline's long-haul network. Previously, Simple Flying revealed the details of Singapore Airlines' 10 Airbus A380 routes. London and Sydney anchor the carrier's A380 network, while India and Australasia fill the rest of the roster. Furthermore, Singapore Airlines had previously planned to add 25% more Airbus A380 flights.

zh.title: NTSB駁回33%FAA華盛頓空難安全建議回應
zh.summary: NTSB指FAA對華盛頓空難建議之三分之一回應無法解決關鍵風險
body: 美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）將美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）針對2025年華盛頓特區（DCA）空難事故所提出的安全建議回應中，高達33%評定為「無法接受」（Unacceptable）並予以駁回。該委員會拒絕了監管機構所提出的三分之一安全處置方案。
根據 Simple Flying 於2026年9月15日的報導，NTSB 表示，FAA 針對華盛頓特區（DCA）事故後續提出的安全建議，仍有三分之一的回應未能有效解決關鍵風險。此項評估顯示，相關安全處置措施目前仍無法滿足關鍵風險的改善要求。

en.title: NTSB Rejects 33% of FAA Responses to Washington DC Crash Safety Recommendations
en.summary: NTSB rejects one-third of FAA safety recommendations responses following 2025 Washington DC crash
body: The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) has classified 33 percent of the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) responses to safety recommendations issued after the 2025 Washington DC (DCA) crash as unacceptable. The NTSB officially rejected one-third of the safety responses submitted by the aviation regulator regarding the recommendations.

According to Simple Flying on September 15, 2026, the NTSB stated that one-third of the FAA's responses to post-DCA safety recommendations still fail to address critical risks. The safety board's assessment indicates that key risk areas identified after the 2025 Washington DC crash remain unaddressed by the FAA's proposed actions.

zh.title: 俄羅斯護衛艦向丹麥芬內克直升機發射照明彈
zh.summary: 俄護衛艦發射照明彈；丹麥召見俄大使；機組平安
body: 俄羅斯一艘護衛艦於2026年9月14日在格瑟（Gedser）外海的國際水域，向一架丹麥皇家空軍芬內克（Fennec）直升機發射兩枚照明彈。丹麥國防司令部於當地時間同日23時02分發布聲明，表示當時直升機正在進行其所謂的例行拍照覆蓋任務。
丹麥國防司令部表示，其中一枚照明彈曾近距離掠過直升機，但未透露護衛艦名稱、直升機單位或遭遇地點。丹麥外交部在2026年9月15日證實已召見俄羅斯大使。
丹麥國防部長Jeppe Bruus表示，機組人員未受傷，直升機也未受損，並形容這項操作是非常不專業的船員行為。這是關乎北歐與波羅的海空域安全的海上軍事互動事件。

en.title: Russian frigate fires flares at Danish Fennec helicopter in Baltic Sea
en.summary: Russian frigate fired two flares at a Danish Fennec helicopter; Denmark summons ambassador; crew safe
body: The Danish Defence Command said a Russian frigate fired two flares at a Royal Danish Air Force Fennec helicopter in international waters off Gedser on September 14, 2026, according to a statement issued at 23:02 local time the same day.

The Danish Defence Command said the helicopter was carrying out what it called routine photographic coverage of the frigate when the flares were fired, and one passed at close range to the aircraft. It did not name the frigate, identify the helicopter's unit, or give a position for the encounter.

Denmark's Ministry of Foreign Affairs confirmed on September 15, 2026, that the Russian ambassador had been summoned, and Defence Minister Jeppe Bruus said the crew was unhurt and the helicopter undamaged. The incident was described as unprofessional seamanship.
